newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says no comment on intervention - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says no comment on intervention - Jiji.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director general of the International Finance Bureau at Japan's Ministry of Finance, said that he would not comment on forex intervention, Jiji news agency reported on Friday.
Jiji also quoted Sakakibara as saying that neither an excessive fall nor rise of the yen was desirable.
Asked about the dollar's rise to 120 yen in afternoon trade in Tokyo, Sakakibara said he would not comment on foreign exchange rates, Jiji said.
But he added: "As the finance minister has mentioned, our stance is that an excessive fall of the yen, as with an excessive rise of the yen, is not desirable."
The greenback hit a fresh 47-month high of 120.15 yen in afternoon trade before profit-taking sales took it lower.
